lineage.description: Population in Need (PiN) estimates were calculated by humanitarian partners through multi-sectoral needs assessment for the health cluster in Colombia. Severity classifications and population disaggregations by age, gender, and vulnerable groups (indigenous, Afro-Colombian, persons with disabilities) were derived from administrative population data (DANE 2024) and humanitarian partner assessments at municipal level.
